articles.title: Integrating Error Tracking for Checkout Reconstruction: 3 Library Practices
articles.excerpt: Short answer: integrate error tracking into the checkout workflow as an evidence pipeline, not as a catch-all exception hook. Capture a stable operation ID, a trace ID, the customer-support-safe reque…
articles.body: Short answer: integrate error tracking into the checkout workflow as an evidence pipeline, not as a catch-all exception hook. Capture a stable operation ID, a trace ID, the customer-support-safe request context, and the failure's original cause at each boundary. Then test the event shape with replayable cases before shipping it. That decision is driven by incident reconstruction. A support agent needs to answer which checkout step failed, what the customer saw, and whether a retry changed the outcome. A stack trace alone rarely answers all three. In a Python eval harness, I treat the event schema as an output contract: given the same synthetic checkout failure, the useful fields should be present, redacted, and linked in the same way every time.

Prima di rilasciare vuole sapere quali sono questi quattro file, cosa ha letto l'assistente per decidere e se si è avvicinato al codice di fatturazione. Una normale finestra di chat le dà solo l'ultimo paragrafo. Maestro in un paragrafo Maestro è lo spazio di lavoro IA con tutti gli strumenti dentro l'app desktop di osFoundry . Scrivi la richiesta come in qualsiasi chat, ma la risposta arriva con il suo percorso di lavoro: ogni file elencato, ogni ricerca eseguita, ogni file letto o modificato e ogni comando da terminale, ciascuno sulla propria riga con una durata che puoi espandere.

articles.title: Building a multiboot Linux menu for the PS4, controlled from the gamepad
articles.excerpt: Linux on the PS4 is not new. Community kernels have run on it for years, and you can find ready-made distros for it. But installing one has always meant a PC, a USB stick or a partitioning step, and a…
articles.body: Linux on the PS4 is not new. Community kernels have run on it for years, and you can find ready-made distros for it. But installing one has always meant a PC, a USB stick or a partitioning step, and a fixed distro picked by whoever built the image. I wanted something simpler: copy any distro's rootfs archive to the console, start Linux, and pick it from a menu on the TV with the controller. Install, boot, add another one, all from the couch. That became PS4 Multiboot . This post is about the problems I had to solve to get there. How Linux starts on a PS4 On a jailbroken PS4, a payload (the PS4 Linux Loader) starts a Linux kernel and initramfs from the console's own drive. From that point everything is a normal Linux boot, with one difference: the initramfs is all you have.

articles.title: A Cloud Agent's 'All Tests Pass' Only Covers the Services It Could Reach

articles.body: Book: Ship It — the pragmatic startup tech stack Also by me: Thinking in Go (2-book series) — Complete Guide to Go Programming + Hexagonal Architecture in Go My project: Hermes IDE | GitHub — an IDE for developers who ship with Claude Code and other AI coding tools Me: xgabriel.com | GitHub The cloud agent opens its pull request with a tidy summary: all tests pass. You pull the branch, run the suite on your laptop, and the integration folder goes red. Nobody lied. The agent's machine had no route to the staging auth service that lives behind your VPN. The fixture that needs it called pytest.skip , and a skipped test is not a failed one. The summary was true for the tests that ran.

articles.title: Direct-to-Storage Browser Uploads for Fintech Media — Retention Before Convenience
articles.excerpt: Short answer: the simplest way to implement direct-to-storage browser uploads for web apps is a presigned URL. The browser sends media directly to object storage, so the application does not become a…
articles.body: Short answer: the simplest way to implement direct-to-storage browser uploads for web apps is a presigned URL. The browser sends media directly to object storage, so the application does not become a file-transfer proxy. For a fintech SaaS product, the important qualification is retention: choose the storage layer only after deciding how objects expire, whether an accidental overwrite can be recovered, and how deletion is recorded. That decision is less glamorous than upload throughput. It is also where the incident usually starts. What does the alert actually tell you? The page fires at 02:17: a customer-uploaded statement is missing from the review queue. The application logs show a successful request to create an upload, but the object is gone.

articles.title: What's that bright 'star' in the early morning sky? It's not a star at all!
articles.excerpt: Spotted a dazzling light in the eastern sky before sunrise? It's Venus, and the planet is only going to get brighter as it heads toward its spectacular peak later this month.
articles.body: Early morning risers heading to work or school before sunrise are likely to notice a very bright, star-like object appearing low in the east-southeast sky just before sunrise. What is somewhat amazing is that just a couple of weeks ago this object wasn't there at all, but now it literally stands out with such brilliance as to almost command the attention of commuters who might be traveling in an easterly direction to "Look at me!" The object in question is, of course, the planet Venus, which is currently amid one of its most spectacular forays into the morning sky, literally "vaulting up" into prominence. On Oct. 24, Venus came to inferior conjunction, passing between the Earth and sun and shifting from the evening into the morning sky.

articles.body: I have been waiting to get my hands on a pair of Unistellar Envision smart binoculars since they were announced in 2024. Our editor-in-chief tried an early demo of them last year and said that they felt like something out of Star Trek . He was, of course, referencing the red augmented reality (AR) overlay in the Envisions that can identify night sky targets and landmarks, as well as displaying navigational tools. articles.title: You can see another galaxy with the naked eye — here's how to find it
articles.excerpt: The Andromeda galaxy is one of the most distant things you can see with the naked eye. The difficult part isn't finding it. It's believing that faint smudge really is another galaxy.
articles.body: The first time I showed someone the Andromeda galaxy (M31), our conversation did not go quite as planned. I'd carefully worked my way across the sky, starting from the Great Square of Pegasus and hopping from star to star until I was confident I had the right patch. I pointed the telescope, got M31 in its crosshairs and proudly announced to my wife that I had found the closest giant galaxy to the Milky Way . Would she like to see it? She then stayed quiet for a little too long as she looked through the eyepiece. Then came an unexpected question. "Is it near that little smudge?" Hmmm. "Err, no. It is that little smudge," I replied. There was a pause. Of course, I knew exactly what had happened.

articles.title: Giant exoplanet emerges from the dark when the James Webb Space Telescope turns out the starlight
articles.excerpt: Astronomers have filtered out starlight from James Webb Space Telescope observations to see a giant exoplanet emerge in the darkness.
articles.body: Sometimes science can seem really counter-intuitive. For example, occasionally in astronomy, you can see more with less light. Case in point: the emergence of a giant planet in observations made by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), when astronomers found a way to block out light from the planet's parent star. The extrasolar planet, or exoplanet , in question is 51 Eridani b (51 ERI b), a gas giant with the same mass as around 11 Jupiters that orbits a star located around 97 light-years away. 51 ERI b was discovered back in 2015 by ground-based telescopes, but the planet was missing from observations of the system made by the JWST.
